warnings.message: pnpm: cooldown not written: minimumReleaseAge belongs to the config dependency @acme/pnpm-policy (include in pnpm-workspace.yaml, line 4), whose settings depcurfew cannot change; written into pnpm-workspace.yaml, it would make pnpm stop with ERR_PNPM_DUPLICATE_SETTING
warnings.fix: Take minimumReleaseAge out of the list of @acme/pnpm-policy in include in pnpm-workspace.yaml, then run depcurfew apply again, which writes it into pnpm-workspace.yaml; or set minimumReleaseAge to 4320 in the settings of @acme/pnpm-policy

warnings.message: pnpm: allowBuilds takes package names only; "@scope/*" not written
warnings.fix: List the package names in installScripts.allow

warnings.message: pnpm: allowBuilds not written: allowBuilds belongs to the config dependency @acme/pnpm-policy (include in pnpm-workspace.yaml, line 4), whose settings depcurfew cannot change; written into pnpm-workspace.yaml, it would make pnpm stop with ERR_PNPM_DUPLICATE_SETTING
warnings.fix: Take allowBuilds out of the list of @acme/pnpm-policy in include in pnpm-workspace.yaml, then run depcurfew apply again, which writes it into pnpm-workspace.yaml; or set allowBuilds as depcurfew.json requires in the settings of @acme/pnpm-policy

warnings.message: pnpm: blockExoticSubdeps stops git and tarball sources only for indirect dependencies; direct ones stay allowed
warnings.fix: Run depcurfew doctor, which reports direct ones in pnpm-lock.yaml

warnings.message: pnpm: blockExoticSubdeps not written: blockExoticSubdeps belongs to the config dependency @acme/pnpm-policy (include in pnpm-workspace.yaml, line 4), whose settings depcurfew cannot change; written into pnpm-workspace.yaml, it would make pnpm stop with ERR_PNPM_DUPLICATE_SETTING
warnings.fix: Take blockExoticSubdeps out of the list of @acme/pnpm-policy in include in pnpm-workspace.yaml, then run depcurfew apply again, which writes it into pnpm-workspace.yaml; or set blockExoticSubdeps to true in the settings of @acme/pnpm-policy
